title.orig: 九章算術·方田（分數諸術）
title.en: The Nine Chapters: The Arts of Fractions
title.zh: 九章算术·方田（分数诸术）

author.dates_zh: 成书不晚于公元 1 世纪

year_display.zh: 约成书于公元 1 世纪

edition.en: The main text of problems 5–18 of Chapter One (Fang tian), as given on Chinese Wikisource; the commentaries of Liu Hui and Li Chunfeng printed with it, and the modern problem numbers, are omitted.
edition.zh: 据中文维基文库《九章算術》卷第一“方田”第五至第十八问的经文；所附刘徽注、李淳风等注释及现代题号均从略。

basis.en: A classical Chinese text about two thousand years old; public domain everywhere.
basis.zh: 约两千年前的中国古籍，在各地均属公有领域。

note.en: The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art, compiled in Han China, is a book of problems, answers and ‘arts’ (shu), that is, methods. These are its arts of fractions: reducing, joining, subtracting, comparing, levelling and dividing. The art of reducing fractions is a complete algorithm for the greatest common divisor by repeated subtraction, the same idea as Euclid’s, written down independently on the other side of the world. Liu Hui’s commentary, omitted here, adds the reason it works: every number subtracted is a multiple of the common measure.
note.zh: 《九章算术》成书于汉代，是一部由问题、答案和“术”（即算法）组成的书。这里收录方田章中的分数诸术：约分、合分、减分、课分、平分、经分。其中约分术的“更相减损”，是用反复相减求最大公约数的完整算法，与欧几里得的思路相同，却是在世界另一端独立写下的。此处从略的刘徽注补上了它为何成立：所减去的每个数，都是那个“等数”的重叠。

excerpt.orig: 可半者半之；不可半者，副置分母、子之數，以少減多，更相減損，求其等也。
excerpt.en: If both can be halved, halve them. If not, set down the denominator and the numerator side by side; take the lesser from the greater, and go on subtracting each from the other in turn, to find the number in which they become equal.
excerpt.zh: 可半者半之；不可半者，副置分母、子之数，以少减多，更相减损，求其等也。

gloss.en: ‘Of eighteen parts, twelve’: the way fractions are still read in Chinese, denominator first.
gloss.zh: “十八分之十二”，即把整体分成十八份取其十二。今天的汉语仍这样读分数，先说分母。

gloss.en: 約 is to reduce a fraction to lowest terms.
gloss.zh: 约，约分。

gloss.en: 荅 is an old form of 答: the answer.
gloss.zh: 荅，同“答”。

gloss.en: If both numbers are even, halve them first: a shortcut before the general method.
gloss.zh: 分子分母都是偶数的，先折半，这是一般方法之前的捷径。

gloss.en: To set the numbers down side by side on the counting board.
gloss.zh: 在算筹盘上把两个数并列摆出。副，在旁。

gloss.en: Subtract each from the other in turn until the two are equal: the subtractive form of what is now called Euclid’s algorithm.
gloss.zh: 两数反复交替相减，直到相等。即今天所说辗转相除法（欧几里得算法）的相减形式。

gloss.en: 等數, the ‘equal number’ reached at the end, is the greatest common divisor.
gloss.zh: 等数，相减到最后相等的数，即最大公约数。

gloss.en: 合 is to put together: to add.
gloss.zh: 合，相加。

gloss.en: Each denominator multiplies the numerators of the other fractions: cross-multiplication, which brings all to a common denominator.
gloss.zh: 各分母交叉去乘其他分数的分子，相当于通分。

gloss.en: 并 is to add; 實, ‘the substance’, is the dividend.
gloss.zh: 并，相加。实，被除数。

gloss.en: 法, ‘the standard’, is the divisor: here the product of the denominators.
gloss.zh: 法，除数。这里是各分母的乘积。

gloss.en: ‘The dividend, as many times as the divisor, gives one’: the standard phrase for division.
gloss.zh: “实如法而一”，即用法去除实，古代除法的固定说法。

gloss.en: To name the remainder as parts of the divisor: to write it as a fraction.
gloss.zh: 以除数作分母，把余数写成分数。

gloss.en: Simply add them: with a common denominator, only the numerators are added.
gloss.zh: 直接相加。分母相同，只需把分子相加。

gloss.en: Which is more: these are comparison problems.
gloss.zh: 哪个多。这是比较大小的题目。

gloss.en: 課 is to test or compare: the art of comparing fractions.
gloss.zh: 课，考核、比较。比较分数大小的方法。

gloss.en: Take from the more and add to the less until all are level: finding the average.
gloss.zh: 减多补少，使各数相等，即求平均数。

gloss.en: The art of levelling fractions: the arithmetic mean, reached by moving parts from larger terms to smaller.
gloss.zh: 求几个分数的平均数，并求出各数应减应补的量。

gloss.en: The ‘level dividend’: the sum of the cross-multiplied numerators.
gloss.zh: 各分子交乘之积的总和。

gloss.en: The dividend for each term separately, multiplied by the number of terms.
gloss.zh: 每一项各自的被除数，再乘以项数。

gloss.en: A copper coin, the everyday unit of money.
gloss.zh: 铜钱，日常的货币单位。

gloss.en: A third of a person: the arithmetic does not mind, and the problem uses it to show division by a mixed number.
gloss.zh: 三分之一个人。算术并不在乎，题目借此演示用带分数作除数。

gloss.en: The art of dividing with fractions. 經 is often read as 徑, directly: dividing straight through.
gloss.zh: 分数除法。一说“经”通“径”，即直接相分。

gloss.en: 通 is to bring through: turn a mixed number into an improper fraction.
gloss.zh: 通，通分化整为分，即把带分数化为假分数。

gloss.en: Where both dividend and divisor have fractions, first give them a common denominator, then bring them through.
gloss.zh: 被除数与除数都有分数的，先使分母相同，再化为分数。
